title: CLCON/10/2017 of Smt Basanti Devi AND OTHERS Vs Beer Singh AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLCON No. 10 of 2017
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Heard Mr. Navnish Negi, Advocate for
the applicant.
This contempt application has been
filed alleging willful disobedience of the order
dated 03.11.2014 passed in WPMS No. 1300
of 2012. The said order is reproduced below
for ready reference:
ìWith the consent of learned counsel
for the parties, present petition is being
disposed of in the following terms:-
(i) petitioners shall handover
peaceful, vacant, actual physical
possession to the landlord on or before
30.11.2015.
(ii) Petitioners shall pay entire
arrears of rent and mesne profit from
the date of judgment of the trial court
on or before 30.11.2014 and shall keep
paying on monthly mesne profit in
advance on or before 10th day of each
and every month.
(iii) Petitioners shall file
undertaking to the above effect in the
Trial Court in the shape of affidavit on
or before 30.11.2014.
(iv) If undertaking to the above
effect is not furnished or arrears of rent
and mesne profit are not paid till
30.11.204 or any default is made in the
payment of monthly mesne profit,
landlord shall be entitled to evict the
petitioners forthwith with the help of
police, at the risk and cost of the
petitioners.î

A bare perusal of the order contempt
whereof has been alleged indicates that writ
petitioner (tenant) was required to give an
undertaking in the shape of affidavit before
learned trial Court that he will hand over
peaceful, vacant, actual physical possession
to the landlord on or before 30.11.2015. The
consequence of any default of the condition
mentioned in the order has also been
indicated in the order dated 03.11.2014.
Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that despite undertaking given by
the tenants (opposite parties herein), they
have not vacated the premises in question. If
that is so, the applicant is at liberty to seek
police help in terms of the aforesaid order.
Thus, remedy of the applicant lies
elsewhere and not by way of filing contempt
application.
Accordingly, contempt application is
dismissed. Contempt notices issued against
opposite parties are hereby discharged.
However, applicant shall be at liberty to
approach the concerned Police Station for
help in terms of the order passed by this
Court on 03.11.2014. The police authorities
shall thereafter take appropriate action in
accordance with law.
